استفللت (form X)
# اِسْتَفْلَلْتُ (istaflaltu) /is.taf.lal.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَفَلَّ (istafalla)
# اِسْتَفْلَلْتَ (istaflalta) /is.taf.lal.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَفَلَّ (istafalla)
# اِسْتَفْلَلْتِ (istaflalti) /is.taf.lal.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَفَلَّ (istafalla)
